note: Format v4 Phase 2 look presets (data, not code). base = the createLook preset fields; v4 = tone mapping, env, bake, glow, grade. Tuning pass 1 (look-ab sheet): comedy exposure 1.1→1.45 + LUT saturation 1.15→1.3 (AgX desaturates); mystery exposure 1.0→1.7, hemi .35→.9, moon .55→1.3, baked sky .38→.7 (actors were unreadable). Phase 2b: comedy tone mapping Khronos PBR Neutral (keeps saturation), exposure 1.0; mystery keeps AgX. Phase 3b: `toy` (bright interior, practicals baked) and `dawn` (rose horizon, low warm sun) for the Toy House sets. Phase 3b-R: toy = muted hazy interior (fog 30-260 + height haze), material classes (v4.materials), cool strips baked; toyTop = toy for straight-down shots (haze pushed past the floor); dawn retuned warm gold (less mauve). Look 5b (opt-in spec look5b): `v5b` per preset = actor fresnel rim (colour, strength, power), actor lift actorEV vs the world, world grade envEV + envCool, exposureEV (daylight/toy +0.5, night 0), contact blob, camera noise, overshoot, breathing, springs, motion blur. Look 6: toyNight / toyNightTop / toyLate / toyDawn = after-hours hall (baked light layers mixed per state, block v6); rim (owner, 8159612) x0.4, power 4, away from the key in every toy-family v5b block.

cityDay.note: Phase 1A (opt-in look4 "cityDay", parts/city/world.js): bright late morning on the island city. High south-east sun (el 60), crisp shadows, saturated blue sky + puffy clouds, no near haze (fog starts at 480), AgX tone, bake = contact AO + sun visibility per district.

cityDay2.note: Look Signature (opt-in look4 "cityDay2"; cityDay stays as it was): the Roblox Studio showcase recipe. Crisp high sun with a stronger key-to-shadow bake ratio, blue sky fill (never grey), warm ground bounce, haze tinted to the scene's average colour on distant terrain only (fog from 300), mild grade (+sat, warm highlights / cool shadows), 3-stop sky gradient, 2 cloud sizes, faint sun rays only when the sun is in frame. outline: off | classic | classicPlus (engine/outline.js; owner decision Phase 1D: classic is the city default, classicPlus available).

cityGoldenHour.note: Phase 1F (opt-in look4 "cityGoldenHour"; look B): CLEARLY golden — a low warm west sun (el 9) with long shadows, an orange-to-peach sky gradient (orange zenith → peach horizon), honey key and warm bounce, soft violet shade fill; clouds peach; lamps off, duck beam off.

cityDusk.note: Phase 1E (opt-in look4 "cityDusk"): sun just under the west horizon, orange-to-violet sky, cool blue fill, warm lit windows, street lamps on, the duck beam sweeping, the Governor blimp lit; no moody grade (bright, readable).

cityNight.note: Phase 1F (opt-in look4 "cityNight"): REAL night — global exposure down, a moonlit blue key, dark water and ground; street lamps (baked pools on the statics + warm glow on the terrain), lit windows, the duck beam and the lit blimp carry the light; characters stay readable through a soft cool rim + lift on the actor matcap. Starry sky, clouds off.
